verdict.rationale: Jules is driven by natural-language tasks: you submit a task and it generates a plan for approval, you can message the agent mid-session via the web app or API, and you can assign work from a GitHub issue. Community users confirm they operate it by prompting, feeding back error messages, and even dispatching tasks from a phone. Missing for 10: first-party docs never explicitly describe the natural-language prompt interface, and users report no way to stop a looping session (no 'STOP' control).
